scope: Read-only code inspection and in-memory synthetic metadata probes. No product implementation or new resource integration.

directoryMeaning.label: side-table-surface
directoryMeaning.meaning: Installation purpose and required actual sample coverage. It is not a runtime mount or an exclusive parent compatibility rule.
directoryMeaning.mapping: Production resource uses support-surface. Instance directly parents to a supporting facility and selects attachment.surfaceId=top.
directoryMeaning.currentStrictBoundary: Direct facility parent with matching surface. Entire rotated mounting envelope rests at topY and fits surface halfSize/clearance. Same-parent supported envelopes may not overlap.

minimalFutureChange.production: Translate directory purpose to existing runtime mount and instance attachment. No new mount system, render transform, persistence format or copying operation is needed.
minimalFutureChange.finiteResourceGate: If the final static family contract fixes dimensions/allowed fields, add a bounded family resource validator through existing validateSupportResource. Validate positive integer version and ordinary new IDs. Enforce agreed role/branch, support-surface, bottom mounting, nonblocking footprint, empty usePoints/state and agreed finite fields.
minimalFutureChange.sampleSelection: Use the separate family role to avoid old support/vanity samples that enumerate tabletop-ornament resources.
minimalFutureChange.compatibility: Four looks and future IDs/versions can share an identical functional signature. Existing tabletop-ornament mounting .16 x .20 x .12 differs from pending .18 x .25 x .18 and is not automatically replacement-compatible.
minimalFutureChange.parentAdmission: Reuse generic parent support fit. No side-table-only rejection was requested by the root.

resource.asset: Actual GLB URL/SHA256/bytes after source selection

provisionalInterface.dimensionsStatus: Pending actual source review. The fourth appearance is one pen-holder-and-notebook combination.

pendingFitMath.limitation: Only the named .30 x .22 patch counts as the guaranteed child support. Body envelope does not enlarge it. Final source geometry may require an explicitly reconsidered common envelope.

preservedMechanisms.identity: ID and positive version refs, globally unique instance IDs, catalog identity, parent existence/cycle checks.
preservedMechanisms.hierarchy: Derived recursive ancestor transforms and shared effective local adapter. Static support has no motion accumulation.
preservedMechanisms.copy: Find copied children by parentId and resource/attachment. Opaque generated IDs must not be assumed.
preservedMechanisms.save: Complete resource/template definition SHA256 dependency pins preserve rest transforms, hierarchy, attachment and static state. Same ID/version content drift is rejected.
preservedMechanisms.transaction: prepareCompanyChange clones and derives before return. Authoring and save store generation/revision/write intent gates remain the existing path. No actor/lease changes needed.

necessaryFutureBadCases: Wrong role/branch/runtime mount, invalid version, unknown functional fields, accidental state/light/moving/support capability.
Wrong structural parent, unknown or malformed attachment, missing parent, parent cycle, and missing resource/version.
Rest height mismatch, rotated mounting overhang, excessive height, same-parent overlap and duplicate copied IDs.
Changed function replacement, stale prepared commit, asset fetch/hash/parse/geometry failure, and same-version dependency drift must preserve prior live scene and stored save.
Correctly sized compatible support on a different parent role remains allowed. The actual package sample still installs on a side table.
pendingActualSourceWork: Verify exact original source/license/archive paths/SHA and adaptation recipe for all four appearances.
Set actual bottom origin, common envelope, source geometry preservation and real positive-area support/contact. Generic lowest-Y check alone does not prove stable contact.

Validate cup/bottle thickness and openings, tissue opening/contents, pen holder/notebook composition, internal component contact and any textures/material/transparency requirements from actual sources.
Run actual GLB envelope and geometry gates, byte/hash fetch evidence, authoring replacement/adjustment/copy/save/reopen, and browser lighting/material rendering after production.
Record actual source/runtime limits without treating metadata probes or mocked meshes/fetch as external asset integration.
evidenceLimits: All probes below are synthetic metadata only. No GLB fetch/load, geometry gate, mesh construction, renderer, browser, GPU or external source verification was performed.
